privateDeals.what: BlackRock-GIP-TiL consortium agreed in principle to buy 80% of CK Hutchison's ports business (43 ports, 23 countries; EV US$22.8bn) plus 90% of Panama Ports Co.; deal postponed amid Chinese regulatory scrutiny
MSC Cruises ordered four 'New Frontier' ships (+2 options, ~180,000 GT) from Meyer Werft, deliveries from 2030
MSC Cruises ordered World Class 7 and 8 from Chantiers de l'Atlantique for EUR3.5bn (deliveries 2030-31)
MSC agreed to take 49% of Spain's Boluda Towage via contribution of MedTug
MSC agreed to acquire 56.47% of Brazil's Wilson Sons (~$768m)
Blue Media (MSC) acquired Genoa newspaper Il Secolo XIX
Aponte reported by Bloomberg to have personally helped broker the Hutchison ports deal with Li Ka-shing

trophies.what: Il Secolo XIX (Genoa daily newspaper, founded 1886) owned via MSC's Blue Media Srl since Sept 2024
Ocean Cay MSC Marine Reserve, Bahamas - private island held by MSC Cruises on a 100-year lease signed Dec 2015 (company asset)

policy.what: Panama canal ports: after Panama's Supreme Court voided CK Hutchison's Balboa and Cristobal concession (Jan 29, 2026), interim operations passed to MSC and APM Terminals (Maersk); per FT (Apr 2026) China's NDRC demanded MSC and Maersk withdraw; CK Hutchison started international arbitration against Panama seeking >US$1.5bn (Aug 20, 2026)

MSC Elsa 3 capsized off Kochi, Kerala (May 25, 2025) with 640+ containers incl. hazardous cargo; Kerala declared a state disaster, coastal police registered a criminal case (FIR) against the master and crew; plastic-pellet pollution still found in 2026
MSC Gayane seized by U.S. CBP after ~20 tons of cocaine found in 2019 Philadelphia seizure; MSC denied intentional involvement (older, 2019)

giving.name: MSC Foundation (Geneva; chaired by Capt. Gianluigi Aponte; marine conservation, community, education, emergency relief)

watch.what: Fate of the BlackRock-GIP-TiL purchase of CK Hutchison's ports (postponed; Chinese regulatory review)
Panama re-tender of Balboa/Cristobal concessions currently run on an interim basis by MSC and APM Terminals; CK Hutchison arbitration vs Panama (filed Aug 20, 2026)
Post-handover MSC governance: ownership now with Diego Aponte and Alexa Aponte Vago - watch whether Forbes/Bloomberg re-attribute the MSC fortune
MSC Cruises / Explora fleet growth (Explora IV and V due 2027)

gaps: Conflict: Forbes (Sept 2026) still credits Gianluigi and Rafaela with 50% of MSC each, while MSC/Bloomberg report ownership was transferred to their children in Q4 2025; exact post-transfer split not disclosed. MSC is private: no tickers, CIKs or 13F filers (EDGAR searches returned nothing). Several deal facts rely on Wikipedia because trade press (Splash247, Seatrade, JOC) and Reuters blocked fetching. No reputable real-estate reports found; personal homes of the family deliberately excluded. Kerala compensation litigation amounts not verified. Web search budget ran out, limiting depth.
